entities.summary: Jacob L'Okori Oulanyah was a Ugandan agricultural economist, lawyer, and politician, who served as the speaker of the 11th Parliament of Uganda from 2021 to 2022. He was elected to that position on 24 May 2021, after defeating his tenacious rival, incumbent Speaker Rebecca Alitwala Kadaga.
